clips.label: Tidal world · clean reference
clips.note: Tracks the original forms more closely; surface finish can still drift.
clips.details: Two seconds, eighteen paintings at native 1536×1024, 24 fps, identical RIFE finishing outside feedback. Same opening, camera, full scene/material text, seed trajectory, 0.72→0.615413→0.373081→0 Euler schedule and CFG1. Adds Krea Identity Edit v1.2 (strength 1), image-grounded prompt encoding and clean VAE reference tokens from the same already-warped previous painting, plus a fixed preservation instruction. Reference attention boost 1. Previous-image initialization remains active. No masks, pixel copyback or refinement pass.

clips.label: Tidal world · usual repaint
clips.note: The existing 0.72 repaint, with the same camera and seeds.
clips.details: Two seconds, eighteen paintings at native 1536×1024, 24 fps, identical RIFE finishing outside feedback. Plain Krea 2 Turbo with previous-image initialization and ordinary text conditioning. No additional clean reference. This is a new matched control, not the original full film.
